hero.subtitle: Pulse.Jc is a 1-to-1 chat with live presence, typing indicators and read receipts — plus an AI assistant that streams its replies as it writes them.

mockup.ai1: I can answer questions, help you write a message or just chat — in English or Spanish.
mockup.ai2: Yes — you're watching me type this, word by word

features.label: What's inside
features.title: Everything a chat needs
features.subtitle: The essentials of a modern messenger, built from scratch.

realtime.title: Real-time messaging
realtime.desc: Messages arrive instantly over WebSockets, with online presence, typing indicators and read receipts that update live.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.desc: Chat with Pulse AI, powered by Google Gemini. Replies stream in as they're generated, in your app's language.

contacts.title: Contacts & notifications
contacts.desc: Add people by email, accept or decline requests, and get notified in real time — with an inbox for everything you missed.

i18n.title: Bilingual, light & dark
i18n.desc: Full Spanish and English interface and a theme that follows your system — both saved to your account.

pro.title: Free & Pro plans
pro.desc: A Pro subscription with Stripe Checkout and the Customer Portal raises the daily AI message limit. (Test mode — no real charges.)

security.title: Secure by design
security.desc: httpOnly cookies with rotating refresh tokens, Google sign-in, rate limiting and a strict Content Security Policy.

built.label: Under the hood
built.title: How it's built
built.subtitle: A full-stack TypeScript project, deployed and monitored like a production app.

architecture.title: React + NestJS
architecture.desc: React 19 with TanStack Query and Zustand on the client; a modular NestJS API with Prisma and PostgreSQL on the server.

streaming.title: Streaming over Socket.io
streaming.desc: AI replies are forwarded chunk by chunk to the user's room, with retry status and quota-aware error handling.

cicd.title: CI/CD
cicd.desc: GitHub Actions runs lint, type checks, unit and e2e tests on every PR, then deploys to EC2 through short-lived OIDC credentials.

aws.title: AWS
aws.desc: A single EC2 instance behind Nginx with PM2, S3 for avatars and SES for transactional email.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.desc: Sentry on both server and client, with session replays for errors, plus uptime monitoring.

performance.title: Performance
performance.desc: Route and modal code splitting plus a long-lived vendor chunk halved the initial bundle.

cta.title: Ready to say hi?
cta.subtitle: Create an account in seconds — or sign in with Google.
